Author of the Mahākāvya called Haravijaya and patronized by Avantivarman (855-884 A. D.)

Author of the Bāla-Rāmāyaṇa, Bāla-Bhārata, and Viddhaśālabhañjikā. He lived after Bhavabhūti and before the end of the tenth century, that is, he flourished between the end of the 7th and the middle of the 10th century
